handbookNote: Batch-2 depth expansion for Missouri notary (RSMo Chapter 486). Same statutory source as batch 1 (Missouri Revised Statutes Chapter 486, Notaries Public and Notarial Acts, L. 2020 H.B. 1655, eff. 28 Aug 2020) plus RSMo 578.700 (notary-related criminal penalties), all retrieved directly from revisor.mo.gov on 2026-08-15. This batch was written to deepen coverage beyond batch 1's ~30 sections by grounding new questions in ~40 additional sections/subsections batch 1 did not use (486.600/486.900/486.1100 definitions; 486.635, 486.680, 486.690, 486.695, 486.745, 486.770, 486.785, 486.820, 486.825, 486.830 in the general chapter; 486.902, 486.915, 486.920, 486.930, 486.935, 486.945, 486.947, 486.950, 486.960, 486.965, 486.970, 486.975, 486.980, 486.985, 486.990, 486.995, 486.1000, 486.1005, 486.1010 for electronic notaries; and 486.1105, 486.1115, 486.1130, 486.1135, 486.1140, 486.1150, 486.1160, 486.1165, 486.1170, 486.1175, 486.1180, 486.1185, 486.1190, 486.1195, 486.1200, 486.1205 for remote online notarization), plus scenario/application questions applying already-covered rules to new concrete fact patterns. Price matches batch 1 and this project's established Notary tier ($9.99), not a placeholder. Does not modify or duplicate batch-1 questions (separate questionsDir; batch-2 question IDs auto-prefix with -b2- during build).
